The '''''Tenacious''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in operation during the early stages of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was helmed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denimoor]].<ref name="DT-FC-3" />

The ''Tenacious'' was illegally redirected to [[Arkinnea]] to [[Rescue on Arkinnea|aid]] the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and his younglings as a favor from the Imperial officer stationed at the planet, [[Teron]], due to the two of them formerly serving under the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master during the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].<ref name="DT-FC-3" />
